# 2. Optimization and Convexity

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills}

## Intro

#### Gradient Descent

The gradient tells us which way to move in order to increase (or decrease) our function value. How do we know we eventually get to our destination? For an arbitrary function, we may never know. But for a convex function we have good guarantees!

#### Convexity

Draw some pictures

#### Convex Optimization

We all know the rules. But what are they good for? Remember the goal is not to know the rules, the rules just help us calculate.
